glosses: ein Ganzes in kleinere Teile (Portionen) aufteilen; so aufteilen, dass es der Menge für eine Mahlzeit (Portion) entspricht

examples.text: Kaufen Sie gleich kiloweise am Stück und portionieren Sie zu Hause selbst.
Abnehmen fällt leichter, wenn die Mahlzeit bereits portioniert auf den Tisch kommt.
In der Pension gab es zum Frühstück Brötchen, Butter und portionierte Marmelade, die in kleine Töpfchen abgefüllt war.
Portionierte Suppen aus der Kühltruhe können schnell aufgewärmt werden.

glosses: That which is divided off or separated, as a part from a whole; a separated part of anything.

examples.text: The Lord of that ſeruant […] will appoint him his portion with the vnbeleeuers.
Man's portion is to die and rise again.
"Everywhere the same!" exclaimed Francesca, as she resumed her seat—"the same human misery—the same human portion!...

glosses: The part of an estate given or falling to a child or heir; an inheritance.

examples.text: Father, giue me the portion of goods that falleth to me.

O! yearning heart! I did inherit
Thy withering portion with the fame,
The searing glory which hath shone
Amid the jewels of my throne,
Halo of Hell!
Commend me to her, and to piece her portion / Tender her this.

I took part of a small house in the Old Jewry; and being advised to alter my condition, I married Mrs. Mary Burton, second daughter to Mr. Edmund Burton, hosier, in Newgate-street, with whom I received four hundred pounds for a portion.

glosses: To divide into amounts, as for allocation to specific purposes.
To endow with a portion or inheritance.

examples.text: Him portioned maids, apprenticed orphans, blest.

glosses: Distribuir uno o varios productos (bienes o servicios) en cantidades limitadas debido a circunstancias aciagas.
Consumir algo en menor cantidad para evitar percances.
Distribuir o proveer de raciones a las tropas.
vt. 把…分成份，（冰淇淋）舀
